openings.claim: Counted order/color kits may reduce mixed-layout selection errors and delays while retaining preassembly.
openings.discriminator: Savings concentrate after layout switches; insertion need not improve.
openings.probe: Twelve builds, six matched pairs; counterbalance workers/order. Separate staging, selection, insertion, checking, packing; audit completeness, bench occupancy and costs.
openings.uncertainty: Layout complexity confounds switching; staging preparation may erase savings.

openings.claim: An ordered-layout drawing identifying the short partition may improve unaided arrangement.
openings.discriminator: Complete kits isolate interpretation from omissions.
openings.probe: Five existing-diagram versus five annotated-slip participants on matched unfamiliar layouts; measure completion, questions, errors, time and annotation labor.
openings.uncertainty: Legibility and labor feasibility remain untested.

openings.claim: An outlined carrier combines completeness stencil and placement map.
openings.discriminator: Empty positions or unmatched marks expose errors while mapping parts to arrangement.
openings.probe: Mock up three counts; seed omissions/substitutions; compare mixed-order work and customer reconstruction.
openings.uncertainty: Same-outline incompatibilities, wrong maps and color mismatches can pass; post-preassembly readability, packaging fit and costs are unresolved. Automatic mapping is unsupported.

openings.claim: A reversible elastic lead-in with seating witness may guide insertion through visible deflection.
openings.discriminator: Deflection predicts misalignment and repeat attempts.
openings.probe: Compare current, witness-only and guided joints; measure attempts, force, cue accuracy, damage, repeated dismantling and specified loads.
openings.uncertainty: Overlapping widths establish no cause; stiffness, travel, seating, moisture and fatigue may defeat guidance.

openings.claim: Reusable outlined staging plus a matching portable slip key retains carrier correspondence under preassembly.
openings.discriminator: Compare incumbent, mat-only, key-only and coupled versions, including independently prepared mappings.
openings.probe: Verify mapping against an assembled sample; screen within fifteen samples and ten participants; count transfer labor.
openings.uncertainty: Shared mapping errors propagate; indistinguishable parts defeat checks; reuse savings may disappear.

decision: Proposed screens, synthetic evidence only. Preserve 30×20 cm footprint, specified assortment capacity, dismantlable/rearrangeable partitions without permanent bonds, accepted counts/colors and fixed delivery. Cap initial spending at 500 and added materials at 0.40/order. Include all labor and single-bench occupancy. Pilot: 60 units, ≥98% complete, median assembly/packing ≤8 minutes, ≥90% unaided arrangement; screens cannot establish these thresholds.
